newsitem.title: USA: Second victim killed in Yellowstone avalanche.
newsitem.headline: Second victim killed in Yellowstone avalanche.

text.p: The body of a second victim of an avalanche in Yellowstone National Park was found Friday, park officials said.
Diane Dustman, 37, of Jamaica Plain, Massachusetts, was working as a volunteer in the backcountry with park geologist Roderick Hutchinson.
Hutchinson's body was found on Thursday.
Dustman worked for Boston Dynamics, a computer software company, and had worked as a volunteer on several computer projects to monitor the park's geothermal features, officials said.
